text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAAGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(One more step forward.
...Just one step forward!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Show me the path to victory,
here on this stage packed with elites!
In this debut battle leading into the future—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Like hell I'm leaving
empty-handeeeeeed!!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Aah... Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...My heart is beating... so damn loud...!
"And on the way back to the waiting room with Nakayama Festa after finishing the Satsuki Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Nakayama Festa!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You ran in the Satsuki Sho this time, but...
is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe still on your schedule?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! The "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe," huh...!
Was that Nakayama just now?
Big mouth as always...

The press corps reacted to her answer.
The TV crew also held up their cameras,
hesitating over whether they should film her—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...If you're hesitating, put the spotlight on me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and report all you want, everyone.
I'm the Umamusume who will prove her strength with the Triple Crown
and bring hope for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa there, aren't you coming on a bit too strong?
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Neither the Umamusume from last year nor the Triple Crown Umamusume before that could reach the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
And yet, an Umamusume who just finished the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa-san,
do you have a moment for a word?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Go ahead?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I've been following you since before your debut.
Ever since—

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ever since the moment you declared you'd go even higher than El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Back then, you challenged her to a race and pressed her with your raw strength. You tried to reach the world stage. But—

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can beat the "El Condor Pasa"
from back when she was also in the Classic tier?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Nowadays, we in the media, as well as you and the other Umamusume, throw around the word "world" far too lightly.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: However, we need to take a much more serious look at this.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That was a sight only the one and only
Umamusume named "El Condor Pasa" could have shown us.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that, are we not perhaps mistaken in thinking
that we, 'too', have drawn closer to the world?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Are you saying we are trapped in a fleeting dream shown to us by El?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Only then should we make our judgment.
Whether or not we should share the same dream as El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Compared to El Condor Pasa,
your caliber is—
choice_data_list: Yes, they have what it takes to conquer the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, busybody.
Stuff like that doesn't matter one bit to us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Like you said, El and I
were born with different talents.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't go spouting off
about how it's impossible and you should quit.
Don't just give up on your own.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna do this, let's chase our dreams together.
When you're searching for romance, having your head in the clouds
is just about right."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, look to hope.
—At the next Derby.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Jordan-san!
Did you set a goal for the next race?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Times might be tough right now, but striving toward your dream to find the strength to heal your injury is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay. I'll do my best~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... So annoying.
What's the point? Goals, dreams, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......The Classics have already started, haven't they?
